newsitem.title: USA: Pine Cone Systems unveils data warehouse product.
newsitem.headline: Pine Cone Systems unveils data warehouse product.

text.p: Privately held Pine Cone Systems Inc on Monday unveiled a performance check program for data warehouses that it said would help executives gauge productivity improvements and increase return on investment.
The program package, including installation, analysis and report generation, costs $35,000, the company said.
"In just 60 days, companies will know the performance, cost, usability and overall efficiency of their warehouse," Pine Cone said in a statement.
The program is designed to uncover information about the efficiency and auditability of data environments and then recommend ways to enhance productivity, the company said.
